decisions.reason: As a large but still boundedly rational maritime services firm, we would judge this distant healthcare and hospitality recruitment offer against aspirations shaped by our maritime strengths and likely redeploy resources because the strategic fit is weak and comparable evidence for success in our core reference group is limited.

This superyacht crew recruitment service builds directly on our crewing network, training capabilities and maritime customer base, so with industry growth and available organisational slack we would keep it while learning whether it can meet aspirations.
